parts.title: Where Does Our Rubbish Go? Full By 2035?! (Part 2) | TheOneApp, Explored EP3
parts.description:
Part 2: be a greasy takeaway box. Down the rubbish chute, burnt at a waste-to-energy plant in Tuas (the heat makes electricity), and the ash taken by barge to Semakau, Singapore's only landfill, expected to be full by about 2035. Then reduce, reuse and recycle right.

Sources: National Environment Agency waste statistics 2025; Ministry of Sustainability and the Environment on the lifespan of Semakau Landfill.
